response: {"turns":[{"id":"M1:T21","text":"And once they click the hyperlink, the system should take them straight to the operational page they wanted."},{"id":"M1:T22","text":"On the admin side, someone with admin privileges needs to be able to add or create a new user and assign them one or more specified roles in the system."},{"id":"M1:T23","text":"Okay."},{"id":"M1:T24","text":"Then the system should show an error message"},{"id":"M1:T25","text":"Mm-hm."},{"id":"M1:T26","text":"if that new user already turns up in the [system name] system."},{"id":"M1:T27","text":"Got it."},{"id":"M1:T28","text":"Yeah, that makes sense."},{"id":"M1:T29","text":"And maybe, I'm not sure it's a must, but it'd be nice if the system also showed an error message"},{"id":"M1:T30","text":"Right."},{"id":"M1:T31","text":"when the new user isn't active in Active Directory."},{"id":"M1:T32","text":"It'd be nice, maybe, if the system opened on the xxx tab as the default tab."},{"id":"M1:T33","text":"Also, the user should be able to create or add a new user either manually or from a template."},{"id":"M1:T34","text":"Okay."},{"id":"M1:T35","text":"And that thing should inherit all the role settings specified in the template"},{"id":"M1:T36","text":"Sure."},{"id":"M1:T37","text":"whenever the user record gets created from the user template."},{"id":"M1:T38","text":"Plus the user should be able to add extra roles manually on top of that."},{"id":"M1:T39","text":"Then for the newly created or added user, the system saves the user info to the database, with the specified roles tied to divisions."},{"id":"M1:T40","text":"And to find the user and check they exist, the system should search the [system name] user display name and user name columns in the user tables."}]}
